description: Module.atom_names is copied when a macro runs: about 96k allocation calls per OptionParser.parse compile at the macro-run atom table copy in backend.rs. The runtime atom table already holds Arc<str> (fz-53f.10). Sharing it means Vec<Arc<str>> through the Rc<String> atom lists in artifact.rs and backend_program.rs and their readers in native codegen and runtime_type_predicate.rs, about six files. Found by the OptionParser session.
title: A macro run shares the module's atom names
